description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Kandawala, Ratmalana D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 521001 - File No. 15/0354 - Ratmalana
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and encumbrances. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with ownership information, property extents, and legal encumbrances, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
